$help: Demo configuration for AI commentary. tools/commentate.py reads this file. Roles live in commentary/roles/<id>/ (role.json + skill.<lang>.md). API keys are never stored here: each provider names the environment variable that holds its key.

mock.$note: No LLM and no API key. Builds factual lines from templates in commentary/mock/<lang>.json. Good for demos and testing.

claude.$note: Uses the official anthropic Python SDK (pip install anthropic).

ollama.$note: Any local server that speaks the OpenAI chat API (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) works the same way.

zh.name: 简体中文
zh.style: 用简体中文写作。比分用冒号（31:29），回合写成“第 N 回合”。队名和模型名保持原样，不要翻译。

en.name: English
en.style: Write in English. Use an en dash for scores (31–29) and 'turn N' for turns. Keep team and model names exactly as given.

generation.$min_turns_between_lines: No two lines (from any roles) closer than this many turns. When roles collide, the higher role priority keeps the slot.
generation.$focus: In big matches, commentators follow the contenders (top teams) instead of narrating every team. Applies when a match has more than 'when_teams_over' teams; 'top' teams by score are the contenders (ties included).
